correctness.rationale: A direct planted-subtree two-time recurrence with leaf base u0=1,v0=0 is proved for all heights. Closing at root gives Q=2(u²+v²), root-flippers=2v²; a distinct one-time count gives F=2u. Excluding F and halving counts temporal orbits correctly. Explicit ratio recurrence and bounded absolutely-convergent log series prove 1/5 limit and orbit entropy. The packaged independent 16-entry boundary dynamic program and distinct one-time DP check heights 1..8; microscopic exhaustive 32,904 configurations check heights 1..3, with observed success. The infinite theorem relies on the algebraic induction, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The count includes mixed temporal 2-cycles not enumerated by the nearest published fixed- or pure-cycle counting results, in a natural graph family used in the historic literature. The asymptotic 4/5 predominance of a stationary root among oscillating global orbits is a nontrivial local/global property and the entropy quantifies the size of the recurrent set. These are mathematically motivated natural invariants, not arbitrary parameter slices; no general-tree count or attraction-basin result is asserted.
